Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. Stay updated with the latest technologies and industry trends. Proficiency in ADO.NET for data access. Experience with Windows Communication Foundation (WCF). Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, including database design and writing complex queries. Experience in developing and managing Windows Services. Knowledge of version control systems, particularly Git and TFS. Experience with message broker systems, such as RabbitMQ. Advantageous Skills and Experience: Previous experience within the financial services industry. Experience with Financial Information eXchange (FIX) protocols. Experience with DevExpress components. Familiarity with unit testing frameworks like xUnit or NUnit for .NET Core. Skills and Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Quick adaptability to new technologies and frameworks. Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality software. Experience Required: Minimum of 3 years of experience in full stack development. Experience in database integration and management. Experience in integrating with internal or external APIs. Working Conditions: Office-based with flexibility. Collaborative and dynamic team environment. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. Apply today!

jobs.detail_description: Key Responsibilities: Data Collection & Management: Collect, cleanse, validate, and organise data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and integrity. Maintain and enhance databases, data warehouses, and data systems. Ensure data governance and quality standards are consistently met. Data Analysis: Analyse large and complex financial datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities. Perform detailed financial and operational data analysis to support strategic business decisions. Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on data findings. Reporting & Visualisation: Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations for business stakeholders. Present findings in a clear and meaningful manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. Support ongoing reporting requirements and business performance monitoring. Collaboration: Partner closely with finance and business teams to understand reporting and analytical requirements. Work alongside technology teams to implement data-driven solutions and improvements. Contribute to cross-functional projects and initiatives. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and operational efficiency. Stay informed about emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in analytics and business intelligence. Required Qualifications & Experience: Education: Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Relevant certifications in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence will be advantageous. Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a Data Analyst role within the financial services, banking, investment, insurance, or related finance sectors. Proven experience working with large datasets and financial reporting environments. Required Technical Skills: Strong SQL skills for querying, analysing, and managing data. Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis and automation. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualisation platforms. Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric including data engineering, data integration, reporting, and analytics capabilities. Familiarity with financial databases, data warehouses, and cloud-based data platforms. Apply today!
